    def _make_mcline_error(self, with_newline):
        """Create a MultilineContinuationError via a real parser run."""
        text = '[section]\noption\n    continuation'
        if with_newline:
            text += '\n'
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser(allow_no_value=True)
        try:
            parser.read_string(text, source='test.cfg')
        except configparser.MultilineContinuationError as e:
            return e
        self.fail("expected MultilineContinuationError")

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_copy(self):
        import copy
        for with_newline in (True, False):
            with self.subTest(with_newline=with_newline):
                e1 = self._make_mcline_error(with_newline)
                e2 = copy.copy(e1)
                self.assertIs(type(e2), type(e1))
                self.assertEqual(e2.args, e1.args)
                self.assertEqual(e2.source, e1.source)
                self.assertEqual(e2.lineno, e1.lineno)
                self.assertEqual(e2.line, e1.line)
                self.assertEqual(e2.errors, e1.errors)
                self.assertEqual(e2.message, e1.message)

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_deepcopy(self):
        import copy
        for with_newline in (True, False):
            with self.subTest(with_newline=with_newline):
                e1 = self._make_mcline_error(with_newline)
                e2 = copy.deepcopy(e1)
                self.assertIs(type(e2), type(e1))
                self.assertEqual(e2.args, e1.args)
                self.assertEqual(e2.source, e1.source)
                self.assertEqual(e2.lineno, e1.lineno)
                self.assertEqual(e2.line, e1.line)
                self.assertEqual(e2.errors, e1.errors)
                self.assertEqual(e2.message, e1.message)

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_pickle(self):
        import pickle
        for with_newline in (True, False):
            with self.subTest(with_newline=with_newline):
                e1 = self._make_mcline_error(with_newline)
                for proto in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
                    pickled = pickle.dumps(e1, proto)
                    e2 = pickle.loads(pickled)
                    self.assertIs(type(e2), type(e1))
                    self.assertEqual(e2.args, e1.args)
                    self.assertEqual(e2.source, e1.source)
                    self.assertEqual(e2.lineno, e1.lineno)
                    self.assertEqual(e2.line, e1.line)
                    self.assertEqual(e2.errors, e1.errors)
                    self.assertEqual(e2.message, e1.message)
